{"id":1563674541,"question_id":3,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 4 months","timestamp":1741174798,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"562 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1563674541/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters","memory":"144.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int lengthOfLongestSubstring(string s) {\n        unordered_map<char,int>mapping;\n\n        int maxlen = 0;\n        int len = 1;\n\n        for(int j = 0 ; j<s.size() ; j++)\n        {\n            char ch = s[j];\n            if(mapping.find(ch) != mapping.end())\n            {\n                j = mapping[ch] + 1;\n                mapping.clear();\n                len = 1;\n            }\n            mapping[s[j]] = j;\n            maxlen = max(maxlen , len);\n            len++;\n        }\n    return maxlen;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"longest-substring-without-repeating-characters","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":406}
